name: Acolyte
description: You have spent your life in service to a temple, learning prayers, rites, and the tenets of your faith. The temple taught you to read and write.

name: Criminal
description: You are an experienced criminal with a history of breaking the law. You have spent a lot of time among other criminals and still have contacts within the criminal underworld.

name: Sage
description: You spent years learning the lore of the multiverse. You scoured manuscripts, studied scrolls, and listened to the greatest experts on the subjects that interest you.

name: Soldier
description: War has been your life for as long as you can remember. You trained as a youth, studied the use of weapons and armor, learned basic survival techniques, and pledged yourself to a regiment.
